en.text: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

zhSimplified.text: 示巴女王听见所罗门的名声，就来到耶路撒冷，要用难解的话试问所罗门；跟随她的人甚多，又有骆驼驮着香料、宝石，和许多金子。她来见了所罗门，就把心里所有的对所罗门都说出来。

zhTraditional.text: 示巴女王聽見所羅門的名聲，就來到耶路撒冷，要用難解的話試問所羅門；跟隨她的人甚多，又有駱駝馱着香料、寶石，和許多金子。她來見了所羅門，就把心裏所有的對所羅門都說出來。

en.text: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门将她所问的都答上了，没有一句不明白、不能答的。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門將她所問的都答上了，沒有一句不明白、不能答的。

en.text: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

zhSimplified.text: 示巴女王见所罗门的智慧和他所建造的宫室、

zhTraditional.text: 示巴女王見所羅門的智慧和他所建造的宮室、

en.text: the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers and their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

zhSimplified.text: 席上的珍馐美味、群臣分列而坐、仆人两旁侍立，以及他们的衣服装饰、酒政，和酒政的衣服装饰，又见他上耶和华殿的台阶，就诧异得神不守舍，

zhTraditional.text: 席上的珍饈美味、群臣分列而坐、僕人兩旁侍立，以及他們的衣服裝飾、酒政，和酒政的衣服裝飾，又見他上耶和華殿的臺階，就詫異得神不守舍，

en.text: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

zhSimplified.text: 对王说：「我在本国里所听见论到你的事和你的智慧实在是真的！

zhTraditional.text: 對王說：「我在本國裏所聽見論到你的事和你的智慧實在是真的！

en.text: However I didn’t believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn’t told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!

zhSimplified.text: 我先不信那些话，及至我来亲眼见了，才知道你的大智慧；人所告诉我的，还不到一半；你的实迹越过我所听见的名声。

zhTraditional.text: 我先不信那些話，及至我來親眼見了，才知道你的大智慧；人所告訴我的，還不到一半；你的實跡越過我所聽見的名聲。

en.text: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.

zhSimplified.text: 你的群臣、你的仆人常侍立在你面前听你智慧的话是有福的。

zhTraditional.text: 你的群臣、你的僕人常侍立在你面前聽你智慧的話是有福的。

en.text: Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—你的 神是应当称颂的！他喜悦你，使你坐他的国位，为耶和华—你的 神作王；因为你的 神爱以色列人，要永远坚立他们，所以立你作他们的王，使你秉公行义。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－你的上帝是應當稱頌的！他喜悅你，使你坐他的國位，為耶和華－你的上帝作王；因為你的上帝愛以色列人，要永遠堅立他們，所以立你作他們的王，使你秉公行義。」

en.text: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

footnotes.text: 9:9 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces, so 120 talents is about 3.6 metric tons

zhSimplified.text: 于是示巴女王将一百二十他连得金子和宝石，与极多的香料送给所罗门王；她送给王的香料，以后再没有这样的。

zhTraditional.text: 於是示巴女王將一百二十他連得金子和寶石，與極多的香料送給所羅門王；她送給王的香料，以後再沒有這樣的。

en.text: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

footnotes.text: 9:10 possibly Indian sandalwood, which has nice grain and a pleasant scent and is good for woodworking

zhSimplified.text: 希兰的仆人和所罗门的仆人从俄斐运了金子来，也运了檀香木和宝石来。

zhTraditional.text: 希蘭的僕人和所羅門的僕人從俄斐運了金子來，也運了檀香木和寶石來。

en.text: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.

zhSimplified.text: 王用檀香木为耶和华殿和王宫做台，又为歌唱的人做琴瑟；犹大地从来没有见过这样的。

zhTraditional.text: 王用檀香木為耶和華殿和王宮做臺，又為歌唱的人做琴瑟；猶大地從來沒有見過這樣的。

en.text: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, more than that which she had brought to the king. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门王按示巴女王所带来的，还她礼物，另外照她一切所要所求的，都送给她。于是女王和她臣仆转回本国去了。 （王上10·14—25）

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門王按示巴女王所帶來的，還她禮物，另外照她一切所要所求的，都送給她。於是女王和她臣僕轉回本國去了。 （王上10‧14－25）

en.text: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

footnotes.text: 9:13 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces, so 666 talents is about 20 metric tons

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他连得，

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他連得，

en.text: in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

zhSimplified.text: 另外还有商人所进的金子，并且阿拉伯诸王与属国的省长都带金银给所罗门。

zhTraditional.text: 另外還有商人所進的金子，並且阿拉伯諸王與屬國的省長都帶金銀給所羅門。

en.text: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one large shield.

footnotes.text: 9:15 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.32 Troy ounces, so 600 shekels was about 6 kilograms or about 192 Troy ounces.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门王用锤出来的金子打成挡牌二百面，每面用金子六百舍客勒；

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門王用錘出來的金子打成擋牌二百面，每面用金子六百舍客勒；

en.text: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

footnotes.text: 9:16 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.32 Troy ounces, so 300 shekels was about 3 kilograms or about 96 Troy ounces.

zhSimplified.text: 又用锤出来的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三百舍客勒，都放在黎巴嫩林宫里。

zhTraditional.text: 又用錘出來的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三百舍客勒，都放在黎巴嫩林宮裏。

en.text: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

zhSimplified.text: 王用象牙制造一个大宝座，用精金包裹。

zhTraditional.text: 王用象牙製造一個大寶座，用精金包裹。

en.text: There were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

zhSimplified.text: 宝座有六层台阶，又有金脚凳，与宝座相连。宝座两旁有扶手，靠近扶手有两个狮子站立。

zhTraditional.text: 寶座有六層臺階，又有金腳凳，與寶座相連。寶座兩旁有扶手，靠近扶手有兩個獅子站立。

en.text: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. There was nothing like it made in any other kingdom.

zhSimplified.text: 六层台阶上有十二个狮子站立，每层有两个：左边一个，右边一个；在列国中没有这样做的。

zhTraditional.text: 六層臺階上有十二個獅子站立，每層有兩個：左邊一個，右邊一個；在列國中沒有這樣做的。

en.text: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门王一切的饮器都是金的，黎巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿都是精金的。所罗门年间，银子算不了什么。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門王一切的飲器都是金的，黎巴嫩林宮裏的一切器皿都是精金的。所羅門年間，銀子算不了甚麼。

en.text: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants. Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

zhSimplified.text: 因为王的船只与希兰的仆人一同往他施去；他施船只三年一次装载金、银、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回来。

zhTraditional.text: 因為王的船隻與希蘭的僕人一同往他施去；他施船隻三年一次裝載金、銀、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回來。

en.text: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门王的财宝与智慧胜过天下的列王。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門王的財寶與智慧勝過天下的列王。

en.text: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

zhSimplified.text: 普天下的王都求见所罗门，要听 神赐给他智慧的话。

zhTraditional.text: 普天下的王都求見所羅門，要聽上帝賜給他智慧的話。

en.text: They each brought tribute: vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year.

zhSimplified.text: 他们各带贡物，就是金器、银器、衣服、军械、香料、骡马，每年有一定之例。

zhTraditional.text: 他們各帶貢物，就是金器、銀器、衣服、軍械、香料、騾馬，每年有一定之例。

en.text: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen that he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门有套车的马四千棚，有马兵一万二千，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門有套車的馬四千棚，有馬兵一萬二千，安置在屯車的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那裏。

en.text: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门统管诸王，从大河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門統管諸王，從大河到非利士地，直到埃及的邊界。

en.text: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

zhSimplified.text: 王在耶路撒冷使银子多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。

zhTraditional.text: 王在耶路撒冷使銀子多如石頭，香柏木多如高原的桑樹。

en.text: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands.

zhSimplified.text: 有人从埃及和各国为所罗门赶马群来。 （王上11·41—43）

zhTraditional.text: 有人從埃及和各國為所羅門趕馬群來。 （王上11‧41－43）

en.text: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, aren’t they written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门其余的事，自始至终，不都写在先知拿单的书上和示罗人亚希雅的预言书上，并先见易多论尼八儿子耶罗波安的默示书上吗？

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門其餘的事，自始至終，不都寫在先知拿單的書上和示羅人亞希雅的預言書上，並先見易多論尼八兒子耶羅波安的默示書上嗎？

en.text: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作以色列众人的王共四十年。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門在耶路撒冷作以色列眾人的王共四十年。

en.text: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门与他列祖同睡，葬在他父大卫城里。他儿子罗波安接续他作王。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門與他列祖同睡，葬在他父大衛城裏。他兒子羅波安接續他作王。
